summary: Dark-to-light page of 11 sections: a black gradient head with a curved base, an overlapping white intro card, a video photo, a zig-zag milestone timeline, vision and mission halves, a values accordion, a dark quality block, counters and five leader cards. Needs milestone years, four values, three commitments and five leaders.

sections.note: black ground with an orange and yellow glow; centered white title and two-line lead; the lower edge is cut in a curve and a white card overlaps it
white rounded card over the head: small tag and heading with an orange key word and one line left, two paragraphs right
wide rounded crowd photo with a centered white play button

(measured as timeline) pale-blue ground; tag, centered heading and line; vertical centre line with round orange nodes, year and milestone label on one side and a white card with an orange icon, title and paragraph on the other, alternating; about nine entries
two halves of equal width: vision on dark, mission on orange, each a heading, an italic line and a paragraph; outer margins left empty
heading right, four numbered accordion rows (one open) with chevrons; the left half is empty
dark band: centered heading with an orange word and a one-line paragraph, then a sub-heading and three outlined-icon columns with a title and paragraph
centered heading and line; three counters as boxed tiles in dark, none and orange scattered across the width (loaded by scroll)
tag, centered heading and line; five white cards (three then two centered), each with photo slot, name, role and a small LinkedIn icon
black glow ground, small tag, heading with an orange word, one line and a white pill button
